subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: What different aspects of their purchase are Amazon reviewers actually talking about?

judge.implied_focus: The specific aspects/dimensions of a purchase that Amazon reviewers evaluate (product performance, build quality/durability, content substance, and comparative standing vs. alternatives)

per_column.name: product_performance_aspect
per_column.rationale: Captures whether the review discusses how well the product functions — a core purchase aspect reviewers talk about.

per_column.name: quality_durability_issue
per_column.rationale: Captures build quality and longevity, a distinct and coherent facet of the purchase-aspect focus, differentiated from raw performance.

per_column.name: content_substance_quality
per_column.rationale: Captures the quality/substance of the review's content or the item's content; a coherent aspect facet, though slightly ambiguous as to whether it targets the product or the review text itself.

per_column.name: comparison_to_alternatives
per_column.rationale: Captures comparative framing against competitors — a recognizable, actionable aspect that reviewers commonly raise.

judge.rationale: The four added columns collectively centre on a single, data-inferable focus: the distinct aspects of a purchase reviewers discuss. Each column is a genuine categorical facet (performance, durability, content substance, comparison) with meaningful, non-trivial value sets rather than mechanical text metrics, so this clearly realises focus inference rather than a grab-bag. Structure is sound — the facets are differentiated at a useful granularity and each carries a 'not_present'/'no_comparison' option to encode aspect presence, giving a coherent multi-aspect decomposition. Minor weaknesses: 'content_substance_quality' is ambiguous (review-writing quality vs. product content) and blurs the aspect-vs-metaquality boundary, and the four aspects are somewhat arbitrarily chosen rather than exhausting the purchase-aspect space (e.g., price/value, shipping, customer service are absent), which slightly caps coherence and structure. The implied focus is clearly actionable — an analyst could quantify which purchase aspects dominate reviews and how sentiment splits within each.
